column3: “Fortresses” is rendered “citadels,” and “shout of alarm” “war cries.”
NASB supplies “its punishment”; “sold” is rendered as present, and “silver” “money.”
“Trample on” is rendered “pant after,” and “poor” “helpless”; “go into the young woman” is rendered “resort to the same girl.”
“The wine of fines” is rendered “the wine of those who have been fined,” and “their god” “their God.”
“Is this not, O people of Israel” is rendered “Is this not so, O sons of Israel?”
“I am about to make totter under you” is rendered “I am weighted down beneath you”; the meaning of the verb is uncertain.
“A place of escape” is rendered “Flight,” and “strong” “stalwart.”
“Handler of the bow” is rendered “He who grasps the bow”; NASB adds “his ground.”
“Strong of his heart” is rendered “the bravest.”
